fee_notes: Royalty tiers down to 3.25% above $125K/mo revenue, 3.0% above $225K/mo. Marketing tiers down to 2.25% above $150K/mo, 2.0% above $250K/mo. Minimums escalate at months 24, 48, 60. 325K pop territory has higher minimums. Tech fee reserved but not currently charged.
raw_excerpt: Royalty/Gross Monthly Service Fee: 3.5% of total Gross Revenues; 3.25% after $125,000.00 per month revenues are reached; 3.0% after $225,000.00 per month are reached. Minimum $495.00. Cooperative Advertising: $425.00 per month or 2.5% of your Gross Revenues if higher.
